intro.text: The drill room gas sensor chirps, then screams. The crown has nicked a pocket of methane, and it is bleeding into the lower deck, heavy and sweet. The bit is still turning, still throwing sparks off the casing. {crew} has a hand on the drill kill switch and is looking at you. Every second you spend deciding, the meter climbs.

options.text: Kill the drill and vent through the reactor stack.
Have {crew} foam the drill room first.

vented.text: {crew} slaps the switch. The crown spins down and the deck goes quiet. You route the gas out through the reactor exhaust stack, which was never meant for it, and the reactor room heats like an oven. But the meter drops. In the silence, the seismic rhythm behind you falters and loses your track.

foamed.text: {crew} floods the drill room with foam before touching anything, then kills the crown. One spark gets through. A blue flame skates across the foam, finds nothing to eat and dies. The gas vents clean. The foam costs you a drum of coolant concentrate.

punched.text: You open the throttle. The crown chews through the pocket, the gas blows past the casing and up the bore behind you, and nothing catches. The ore beyond it is rich. {crew} lets go of the kill switch one finger at a time.

flash.text: You open the throttle. The gas finds a spark. The drill room goes white, then orange, and the blast slams the hatch into {crew}'s shoulder. Fire runs along the conveyor belts. Somewhere under the noise, TOPSIDE is asking for a status report.
